description.value: Sun Garden Chinese is a sit-down Chinese restaurant on Oak Street in Vancouver serving an extensive Cantonese-style menu spanning chicken, beef, pork, seafood, tofu, and vegetarian dishes. The restaurant operates its own online ordering system for takeout. With 63 customer reviews and a broad menu, it is a reliable full-meal stop for cyclists passing through the Oak Street corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the name and address match OSM exactly (3832 Oak St, Vancouver, BC V6H2M5), and provides a phone number (+1 604-733-3922) absent from OSM. The site's online ordering interface and 'Order Online' navigation confirm takeout capability; the menu explicitly lists a 'Vegetarian 新鮮蔬菜類' and 'Tofu 豆腐類' section, confirming vegetarian options. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities.
